members.name: opts
members.description: Root props include opts:CarouselOptions, plugins:CarouselPlugin, orientation horizontal|vertical (defaulthorizontal), setApi(api) and native div props. useEmblaCarousel8.5.2 receives opts then an axis forced from orientation, so orientation wins over opts.axis. setApi receives the actual ready API, not a fabricated index event. Internal select/reInit observations derive canScrollPrev/Next; Previous/Next compose Button with default outline/icon-sm and readable hidden Previous slide/Next slide labels. Their disabled and onClick props are applied before {...props}, so callers can deliberately override them. Item is group with roledescription=slide; Root is region roledescription=carousel and requires caller context name. Content has an outer overflow viewport and inner flex track; className styles the track. Embla supplies drag, focus/resize behavior and snapping. No autoplay is enabled unless a plugin explicitly adds it; there is no built-in pause button, pagination or live announcement. This reference chooses three static slides, nonlooping default options, no plugin and external status from actual api.select subscriptions.

events.name: setApi
events.description: Actual ready Embla API callback; subscribe to api.on(select/reInit) for source snapshots and unsubscribe in caller effect cleanup.
